name: City Shadows
description: Contemporary Chicago, where ordinary people face extraordinary challenges in their daily lives.
seed_prompt: A modern-day urban setting where cops, criminals, and civilians navigate the complexities of city life.
lore_content:
Chicago, the present day. Eight million people, eight million stories. The city runs on ambition, corruption, and the relentless drive to survive another day.

Detective Carmen Rodriguez works Major Crimes in a department riddled with problems. Her clearance rate is the best in the unit, which makes her both valuable and threatening to the old guard. She's investigating a string of disappearances that might connect to City Hall.

Marcus Johnson teaches history at Lincoln High and coaches the basketball team. He grew up on the South Side, got out on a scholarship, came back to make a difference. The gangs are recruiting his students, and he's running out of ways to compete.

Dr. Priya Sharma runs the ER at Cook County General. Gunshots, overdoses, heart attacks - she sees humanity at its worst every night. She's brilliant, exhausted, and privately struggling with an addiction that started as self-medication.

Tony Marinetti is third-generation in the 'waste management' business, which everyone knows is a front. He wants to take the family legitimate, but his uncle Sal thinks that's betrayal. The tension is building toward something that can only end in blood.

Sarah Chen is a journalist at the Tribune investigating a slum landlord whose buildings keep catching fire. Residents die; insurance pays out; the landlord buys more buildings. Sarah's editor is getting nervous about the threats.

Father Michael O'Brien runs a soup kitchen in Pilsen. He struggles with his faith every day, wondering if he's actually helping or just making poverty more comfortable. A dying parishioner confessed something that's shaken him to his core.

In the financial district, Alexandra Moore manages billions for the city's pension fund. She's discovered irregularities that suggest massive fraud. The people responsible have already made one accountant disappear. She's copying files and planning her escape.

origins.name: Blue Collar
origins.description: A lifetime spent working physically demanding jobs, honing toughness and resilience.
traits: Resilient: Advantage on saving throws against poison.

origins.name: Street Smart
origins.description: Growing up on the streets, you learned to survive by your wits and quick thinking.
traits: Light Sleeper: You only need 4 hours of sleep to gain the benefits of a long rest.

origins.name: Privileged
origins.description: Raised in wealth and comfort, you have access to resources and connections others only dream of.
traits: Silver Spoon: Once per day, you can reroll a failed Charisma check.

origins.name: Bookworm
origins.description: You've always preferred the company of books, giving you a wealth of knowledge and a sharp mind.
traits: Keen Mind: You always know which way is north, and accurately recall anything you have seen or heard within the past month.

origins.name: First Responder
origins.description: Years spent dealing with emergencies, you are capable under pressure, and your senses are sharp.
traits: Iron Stomach: Advantage on saves vs disease

archetypes.name: Beat Cop
archetypes.description: A dedicated officer patrolling the streets, upholding the law, and protecting the innocent.

features.name: Lawful Presence
features.description: You gain advantage on Persuasion checks when interacting with law-abiding citizens.

archetypes.name: Private Eye
archetypes.description: A resourceful investigator, uncovering secrets and solving mysteries for those who can afford the truth.

features.name: Keen Observer
features.description: You gain advantage on Investigation checks related to finding clues and hidden objects.

archetypes.name: Street Medic
archetypes.description: A skilled healer, providing medical assistance to those in need, regardless of their circumstances.
starting_equipment: A backpack filled with medical supplies

features.name: Healing Touch
features.description: As an action, you can touch a creature and restore a number of hit points equal to your level + your Wisdom modifier.

archetypes.name: Fixer
archetypes.description: A charismatic negotiator, skilled at brokering deals, resolving conflicts, and finding solutions to any problem.

features.name: silver Tongue
features.description: You have advantage on Charisma checks made to influence someone who is willing to listen to you.

setting_skills.name: City Politics
setting_skills.description: Understanding Chicago's layered power structures — aldermen, unions, gang territories, and police districts. Knowing who really controls what and where the pressure points are.

setting_skills.name: Forensic Awareness
setting_skills.description: Knowledge of modern forensic techniques, crime scene procedure, and digital evidence. Understanding what the police can find and how to use or avoid that process.

setting_skills.name: Neighborhood Knowledge
setting_skills.description: Reading the social dynamics of Chicago's neighborhoods — turf boundaries, community trust, and the unwritten rules that determine who belongs and who is an outsider.

setting_skills.name: Media Savvy
setting_skills.description: Managing public perception, working with or manipulating the press, and understanding how information spreads in a modern city — from newsrooms to social media.
